items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Howard would be glad to see me come, and let me sit in in his place... And at that time they had Bob Cooper and Stanley

ctx.x: Well, it was Howard Rumsey's gig anyway, wasn't it? As far as bass playing went.

Yeah. But he stayed there so long, though, that everyone was under the impression that the club belonged to him, because he built it up, and he had behind his name being used, Howard Rumsey's Lighthouse by the Sea.
And Howard Rumsey's Lighthouse All Stars. Nobody ever mentioned that John Levine owned the club.
